label: Ascent in esse of support between necessary concreta
term: ascent in esse of support between necessary concreta
definition: NecessarySupportAscendsInEsse m w MoreIn esse holds when, for every admitted world v (accessible from w or not) and concrete candidates a and b that both exist at every world accessible from w, if a exists at v and stands to b in the selected relation at v, then MoreIn esse a b: a is more in esse than b. MoreIn has no world argument, so the comparison is rigid: support edges between necessary concreta at different worlds are measured by one and the same grade. Ordinary meaning: whatever sustains a necessary thing's being, anywhere, has more of being than what it sustains. Orientation (not warrant): a source of light is at least as bright as what it lights, wherever it lights it. Counter-patterns it forbids: support between necessary things that runs from the lesser to the greater; and support whose direction between the same two necessary things changes from world to world (each would then be more in esse than the other). It does not require any edge to persist between worlds, does not say that supporters are necessary, and says nothing about contingent supporters; b need not exist at v.
note: Analyst framework definition, attribution deferred; an open premise, not established. Dependencies: DEF-MORE-IN at the respect DEF-ESSE (one primitive comparative, compatible with the univocal and attribution order models of DISAMB-ORDER-OF-BEING), DEF-KANT-MODAL-NECESSITY, DEF-PRESENT-ESSE-SUPPORT and DEF-CONCRETE-SUPPORT-RESTRICTION. Structural properties: it imposes no order law on MoreIn by itself; with STMT-NO-INFINITE-ASCENT-IN-BEING at the same MoreIn and esse it makes the cross-world union of support among necessary concreta well-founded (GradedSupportFoundation.unionWFOfAscent). It is implied by the unrestricted every-world ascent condition. It does not imply coverage or the one-way no-novel-edge condition (Control.OffWorldAscent). Generalization from ordinary causes that have what they give (DEF on CAUSE_2 at esse) to support of necessary beings is an explicit open bridge; the limits of the cause-is-more principle (equivocal and instrumental causes) are recorded in docs/notes/modal-spine.md, Stage two: the join.
